name: streamfog-mcp
description: AI-driven AR lens orchestrator for live OBS streams. Control Streamfog face filters, AR effects, and Vtuber avatars through MCP tools via the local Streamer.bot WebSocket bridge.

tools.name: streamfog_set_lens
tools.description: Activate a specific AR lens or face filter

tools.name: streamfog_clear_effects
tools.description: Strip all effects, return camera to baseline

tools.name: streamfog_list_lenses
tools.description: List all configured lenses from lenses.json
